items.text: Not one store in this chain

items.title: Me
items.text: Four months of talks, tiered rebates

items.label: Per store a year, RMB k

notes: Last year we were in none of this East China electronics chain's stores. I started talks in January and they took four months. The key was a tiered rebate: once annual shipments pass RMB 20m, the rebate goes from 2% to 3%, which got us counter space. After signing, the work was the team's. Two account reps opened the first 40 stores in May and all 120 by September.
